description: Human-in-the-Loop (app/services/approval) inputs. An approval request is only routable from a REAL PolicyDecision whose status is REQUIRES_APPROVAL; the action and target are read from that decision and are never supplied by the client. The service recomputes policy_decision_id from the decision content and rejects a self-inconsistent submission. Four-eyes control is enforced: the requester cannot resolve their own request. RBAC is enforced by the API layer (admin / analyst / ciso).
ttl: app.schemas.approval.APPROVAL_PENDING_TTL = 24 hours (lazy expiry, evaluated on read)

scenarios.purpose: A request created with a clock two hours in the past outlives the app.schemas.approval.APPROVAL_PENDING_TTL = 24 hours (lazy expiry, evaluated on read) TTL. The lazy-expiry reconciliation pass retires it with no user action at all, and an expired request can never be approved.
